answer_1.quote: The dataset includes language processing tasks (such as paraphrasing, validating factuality, entailment, sentiments, classification, dialogue quality, and rationale generation)...
answer_1.outputs: Filled input fields on web forms (text, checkbox selections, radio/select choices, range values, etc.)

answer_2.quote: We devise an evaluation metric that is sensitive to the output type: (i) Text fields: For a given text response, we compute ROUGE metric against each label... (ii) Radio/select fields: We compute an exact match... (iii) Checkbox fields: ... intersection over union metric... (iv) Range fields... absolute (ℓ1) distance... The overall score is an average of all the above responses.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human annotations to better understand the results... Our annotator agreed with GPT4o's responses in 60% (80 out of 134) of the cases...
answer_4.guideline: The annotator reviewed each model response and judged whether it matched the gold label.
